autoload.getCarrierSensorStatus.description: Returns the sensor status for each carrier position on the autoloader.

autoload.loadCarrierById.description: Loads a carrier onto the autoloader by carrier ID, optionally scanning barcodes.

autoload.loadCarrierByTrack.description: Loads a carrier onto the autoloader at a specific track, optionally scanning barcodes.

autoload.moveTo.description: Moves the autoloader to a specified track.

autoload.parkLeft.description: Parks the autoloader in the left position.

autoload.parkRight.description: Parks the autoloader in the right position.

autoload.unloadCarrierById.description: Unloads a carrier from the autoloader by carrier ID.

autoload.unloadCarrierByTrack.description: Unloads a carrier from the autoloader at a specific track.

channels.1mL.aspirate.description: Aspirates liquid using the 1mL pipetting channels.

channels.1mL.detectLiquidLevel.description: Detects the liquid level using the 1mL pipetting channels.

channels.1mL.dispense.description: Dispenses liquid using the 1mL pipetting channels.

channels.1mL.dispenseOnTheFly.description: Dispenses liquid on the fly while the 1mL channels move across labware.

channels.1mL.getStatus.description: Returns the current position and tip status of each 1mL channel.

channels.1mL.moveAxis.description: Moves the 1mL channels along the X, Y, or Z axis.

channels.1mL.tipCheck.description: Checks which tips are currently loaded on the 1mL channels.

channels.1mL.tipPickup.description: Picks up tips using the 1mL channels.

channels.5mL.aspirate.description: Aspirates liquid using the 5mL pipetting channels.

channels.5mL.detectLiquidLevel.description: Detects the liquid level using the 5mL pipetting channels.

channels.5mL.dispense.description: Dispenses liquid using the 5mL pipetting channels.

channels.5mL.dispenseOnTheFly.description: Dispenses liquid on the fly while the 5mL channels move across labware.

channels.5mL.getStatus.description: Returns the current position and tip status of each 5mL channel.

channels.5mL.moveAxis.description: Moves the 5mL channels along the X, Y, or Z axis.

channels.5mL.tipCheck.description: Checks which tips are currently loaded on the 5mL channels.

channels.5mL.tipPickup.description: Picks up tips using the 5mL channels.

channels.MagPip.aspirate.description: Aspirates liquid using the MagPip (magnetic-bead) 1mL pipetting channels.

channels.MagPip.detectLiquidLevel.description: Detects the liquid level using the MagPip pipetting channels.

channels.MagPip.dispense.description: Dispenses liquid using the MagPip pipetting channels.

channels.MagPip.dispenseOnTheFly.description: Dispenses liquid on the fly while the MagPip channels move across labware.

channels.MagPip.getStatus.description: Returns the current position and tip status of each MagPip channel.

channels.MagPip.moveAxis.description: Moves the MagPip channels along the X, Y, or Z axis.

channels.MagPip.tipCheck.description: Checks which tips are currently loaded on the MagPip channels.

channels.MagPip.tipEject.description: Ejects tips from the MagPip channels.

channels.MagPip.tipPickup.description: Picks up tips using the MagPip pipetting channels.

configuration.disableCleanup.description: Disables the automatic cleanup routine on the instrument.

configuration.getConfiguration.description: Returns the instrument's hardware configuration, including arms, channels, and deck properties.

configuration.getDeckDimensions.description: Returns the physical dimensions of the instrument deck.

configuration.getDeckTracks.description: Returns the total, autoloadable, and active tracks on the deck.

configuration.getWasteLocations.description: Returns the configured waste locations on the deck.

firmware.command.description: Sends a raw firmware-level command directly to the instrument.

firmware.debugMode.description: Enables or disables firmware debug mode.

frontCover.isClosed.description: Checks whether the front cover is closed.

frontCover.isLocked.description: Checks whether the front cover is locked.

maintenance.getDailyMaintenanceData.description: Returns the current status of the daily maintenance procedure.

maintenance.getVerificationData.description: Returns the current status of the verification procedure.

maintenance.getWeeklyMaintenanceData.description: Returns the current status of the weekly maintenance procedure.

mph96.aspirate.description: Aspirates liquid using the 96-channel MPH head.

mph96.clearTipSupport.description: Clears the tip support tracking for the MPH96 head.

mph96.detectLiquidLevel.description: Detects the liquid level using the 96-channel MPH head.

mph96.dispense.description: Dispenses liquid using the 96-channel MPH head.

mph96.getStatus.description: Returns the current position and tip status of the MPH96 head.

mph96.moveAxis.description: Moves the MPH96 head along a specified axis.

mph96.parkBack.description: Parks the MPH96 head in the back position.

mph96.parkFront.description: Parks the MPH96 head in the front position.

mph96.tipEject.description: Ejects tips from the MPH96 head.

mph96.tipPickup.description: Picks up a full set of tips using the MPH96 head.

mph96.tipPickupPartial.description: Picks up a partial set of tips using the MPH96 head.

pipArm.getXPosition.description: Returns the current X position of the pipetting arm.

pipArm.moveTo.description: Moves the pipetting arm to a specified X position.

pipArm.parkLeft.description: Parks the pipetting arm in the left position.

pipArm.parkRight.description: Parks the pipetting arm in the right position.

status.getInstrumentType.description: Returns the instrument type (e.g. STAR, Vantage).

status.isConnected.description: Checks whether the instrument is connected.

status.isIdle.description: Checks whether the instrument is idle.

status.terminate.description: Terminates the connection to the instrument.

statusLight.setFrontLight.description: Sets the color, blink, and progress state of the front status light.

statusLight.setInteriorLight.description: Sets the color and state of the interior status light.

transport.1mL.clearHeldLabware.description: Clears the tracked labware held by the 1mL transport gripper.

transport.1mL.ejectGrips.description: Ejects the transport grips on the 1mL arm.

transport.1mL.holdLid.description: Holds a lid using the 1mL transport gripper.

transport.1mL.isHoldingLabware.description: Checks whether the 1mL transport gripper is currently holding labware.

transport.1mL.moveLabware.description: Moves labware from one carrier/site to another using the 1mL transport gripper.

transport.1mL.moveToWaste.description: Moves labware to waste using the 1mL transport gripper.

transport.1mL.returnLabware.description: Returns previously picked labware to its original or a new location using the 1mL transport gripper.

transport.iswap.clearHeldLabware.description: Clears the tracked labware held by the iSWAP gripper.

transport.iswap.getLabware.description: Returns the labware currently held by the iSWAP gripper.

transport.iswap.isHoldingLabware.description: Checks whether the iSWAP gripper is currently holding labware.

transport.iswap.moveLabware.description: Moves labware from one carrier/site to another using the iSWAP gripper.

transport.iswap.moveToWaste.description: Moves labware to waste using the iSWAP gripper.

transport.iswap.putLabware.description: Places labware held by the iSWAP gripper at a target location.
